title.narrative: Labour Rights, Competitiveness and Fairness in the Private Sector: From HRDD and Tax-Justice Perspectives

description.narrative: The Centre for Policy Dialogue and Christian Aid have been in partnership for over five years with a view to establishing an inclusive and just society, which will ensure participation of all market agents in competitive and sustainable economic activities, maintaining transparency and accountability in business activities in Bangladesh. In this connection, both organisations have been partnering in two key areas: (a) ensuring rights and competitiveness in businesses following UNGPs/HRDD and (b) ensuring tax justice in major fiscal and budgetary measures. Given the importance and long-term positive implications for an inclusive and just society, both CPD and CA have agreed to continue their partnership on these two areas with more focused and in-depth studies, analyses, and policy-influencing activities in the coming years. This proposal is prepared for the next one year, considering the above-mentioned broader objectives, focusing on new areas of intervention.
